The '''Interstellar Parcel Service''' or '''IPS''' was a [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporation]] that shipped packages throughout [[the galaxy]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Interstellar Parcel Service first appeared in [[Tod C. Parkhill]]'s [[Canon|non-canonical]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[Best Birthday Ever]],"<ref name="BBE">{{Tales|16|Best Birthday Ever}}</ref> which was released in [[June]] of [[2003]] as part of [[Star Wars Tales 16|''Star Wars Tales'' 16]].<ref name="SWT16">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-032/Star-Wars-Tales-16|text=Star Wars Tales #16}}</ref> The megacorporation would later receive its own entry in the ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[December]] of [[2008]]. The entry made the existence of IPS [[canon]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="CSWE" />

==="Best Birthday Ever"===
[[File:IPS.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Interstellar Parcel Service facility in Mos Eisley]]
{{Quote|Next!''"<br />"''I'm here to retrieve this package.|An IPS employee and Bib Fortuna|<ref name="BBE" />}}
At some point, a [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] present for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], was shipped through the IPS in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]<ref name="BBE" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> One of Jabba's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], was accompanied by the [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] [[Salacious B. Crumb/Legends|Salacious Crumb]] when he visited the IPS to retrieve the present. However, upon arriving at the IPS, Fortuna and Crumb learned that the present was sent to the [[Oversized Package Redistribution Center]] located on Mos Eisley's [[Dune Street/Legends|Dune Street]].<ref name="BBE" />
